subject: Invoice delivery switch and payee designation for newly formed Helio Data Holdings
participants_external: Helio Data Holdings Ltd. Billing Team <billing@heliodata.com>
messages:
From: Diane Park <diane.park@helio-systems.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@ravenbank.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: change invoice recipient & remit details after Helio carve-out

Hi Vivek —

Quick note from the Helio side: as part of last week's close, the billing function for the inference products is moving from Helio Systems, Inc. (US) to the newly formed Helio Data Holdings Ltd. (UK subsidiary). The commercial terms and SOW remain the same. Finance needs Redwood to start sending invoices and payment instructions to the new legal entity and a new billing email endpoint.

Can you confirm what you need from us to update the remit-to and invoice footer? We have attached: the company registration extract and a signed W-9 (US tax admin asked for a copy for their records, happy to provide the VAT registration for the UK entity as soon as it's processed).

Requested changes from our side:
- New invoice recipient: Helio Data Holdings Ltd. (legal name)
- Billing address: 3 Sovereign Quay, Bristol, BS1 4EQ, United Kingdom
- New invoice delivery endpoint: billing@heliodata.com (please route PDF invoices and automated EDI/CSV to this address)
- Payment bank contact: Oliver Grant (oliver.grant@ravenbank.com) will coordinate escrow/lockbox setup for a 30-day transition period

We'd like the cutover to take place for invoices dated 2026-12-01 forward, with a soft-forward of legacy invoices for 60 days. Please confirm any signoff required on your side (POC, AP contact, forms).

Thanks,
Diane Park
Director, Corporate Finance
Helio Systems (on behalf of Helio Data Holdings)

Attachments: Helio_Data_Holdings_Inc_Registration.pdf, W9_HelioData_signed.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@helio-systems.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: change invoice recipient & remit details after Helio carve-out

Hi Diane —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We can do the cutover on 2026-12-01. To make sure the AR handoff is clean, here are the things we need from Helio before we push the route change: 

1) Formal authorization: an official letter on Helio letterhead approving Helio Data Holdings Ltd. as the invoice payee for Redwood invoices and authorizing Redwood to change remit-to and delivery endpoint.
2) Legal name and VAT/TAX details for both the US legacy and new UK entity (if VAT reg is pending, indicate expected registration date).
3) Preferred AP contact for the new entity (name, email, phone).
4) Bank account attestation (if they want funds to route to a new bank) and a copy of the signatory's ID for first-wire verification.

Operational notes from our side:
- We will add billing@heliodata.com as a delivery endpoint and send a test invoice on 2026-11-24.
- We need to update our invoice footer and ledger payee mapping in the billing system; that change will appear on invoices generated starting 12:00am UTC on 2026-12-01.
- For the first 60 days we will CC the legacy finance email (ap@helio-systems.com) on all invoices for reconciliation.

I've looped in Monica (Finance Ops) and Karthik (Customer Success / Contracting) to coordinate any PO or contract amendments.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane@helio-systems.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: change invoice recipient & remit details after Helio carve-out

Diane —

I started the AR change request in our ERP; a couple of clarifications so we can generate tax-compliant invoices: 
- Please confirm the exact legal entity string for the invoice header (including LLC/ Ltd punctuation). You wrote "Helio Data Holdings Ltd." — will that be the full payee line?
- Do you have a UK VAT registration number or an interim tax identifier? If not, we will include a note on the invoice: "VAT registration pending—please provide VAT ID when available."
- For EDI/CSV ingestion, please send a sample SFTP credential or the endpoint schema; billing@heliodata.com is fine for human PDFs but large-volume feeds require SFTP or our EDI endpoint.

We will need the signed authorizing letter (digital PDF is fine) and the bank attestation before we change wire instructions. For US tax purposes we will retain the provided W-9 in our records.

I'll also add Naomi from Tax to confirm any cross-border withholding or reporting implications.

Monica Patel
Revenue Operations — Billing
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: invoice-routing-mapping.csv

From: Diane Park <diane.park@helio-systems.com>

Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@ravenbank.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: change invoice recipient & remit details after Helio carve-out

Monica / Vivek —

Thanks for the checklist. Answers below and attached items: authorization_letter_heliodata.pdf (on letterhead) and the onboarding SFTP details for the EDI feed.

- Invoice header: "Helio Data Holdings Ltd." (exact string, please include the Ltd.)
- UK VAT: registration is in process; expected completion 2026-11-18 — we will provide VAT number as soon as HMRC issues it.
- AP contact: Priya Singh, priya.singh@heliodata.com, +44 117 555 0123
- Bank routing / escrow: Oliver Grant will be the bank contact for the 60-day transition. He provided a bank attestation document to follow by EOD.

We prefer SFTP for machine-to-machine invoice delivery. Credentials: sftp.heliodata.com / account: redwood_heliodata (see attached). Please schedule the test invoice on 2026-11-24 per Vivek's note.

Best,
Diane

Attachments: authorization_letter_heliodata.pdf, sftp_onboarding_details.txt

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@helio-systems.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: change invoice recipient & remit details after Helio carve-out

Hi all —

Quick tax note from Redwood: because payee jurisdiction is changing and invoicing will be made to a UK-registered entity, we need the VAT ID when available. Until we receive the VAT ID, Redwood will generate invoices without UK VAT charged and mark them as "VAT registration pending". If Helio would prefer invoices that include UK VAT now, we would need a backdated VAT registration and legal guidance from your tax counsel.

Also: if Helio expects Redwood to change the withholding treatment for cross-border payments (e.g., different WHT obligations), please confirm now so we can coordinate with Treasury. Otherwise standard US-originated payments will follow our usual remittance rules.

I'll review the authorization letter once you upload it to the HubSpot deal record. If everything looks good I can sign-off on the invoice footer update.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Tax Counsel
Redwood Inference
